title: Which Came First? Vinland Saga Releases, Awards and Story Beats
description: Ten rounds of four events where you pick the earliest or the latest: manga and anime releases, awards, and story beats of the War Arc and Slave Arc. Light spoilers up to the Slave Arc.
notes: First format: four events, one is the earliest (or the latest); dates come from verified release facts and the story order from the manga plot.
